An array of integers called nums with a length of .

Your goal:
Split the array into exactly 3 contiguous subarrays.
Find the minimum possible total cost, which is the sum of the first elements of these three subarrays.

r/unixporn is a popular subreddit for sharing screenshots of your Linux rice. It also acts as a hardware and software survey, by letting everyone know your computer's specs and your workflow. If you don't want to make this information public, you can always spoof this information.

This is a screenshot of my own rice. However, the programs, the specs, the music library... they're all fake. I'll break down how you can spoof each of these components below.
For a new application, create a file called [application_name].desktop at ~/.local/share/applications. For example, let's create a file for Firefox. Add the snippet below to firefox.desktop.
[Desktop Entry]
Icon=firefox
Name=Firefox

The Icon parameter should be a valid icon name from your icon theme. If you want a custom image as the icon…
articles.title: Spoofing terminal screenshots

articles.author: wes5510
articles.description:
들어가며


Design Doc 작성을 자동화하고 싶었다.
디자인 시안을 확인하고, 기획서를 읽고, 코드베이스를 파악해서 초안을 뽑아주는 것. 그게 /design-doc Command의 목표였다.
Command는 금방 만들었다. 문제는 그 다음이었다. Command가 호출할 Custom Agent를 어떻게 설계할 것인가.
두 번의 설계 전환과 여러 실패 끝에 현재 구조에 도달했다. 이 글은 그 여정이다.
처음엔 고정된 4개 Agent를 병렬로 호출하는 구조였다.
/design-doc 실행
    ↓
Main Agent가 4개 Agent 병렬 호출
├── code-researcher (코드베이스 분석)
├── doc-researcher (내부 문서 분석)
├── external-researcher (외부 도구 전부)
└── app-researcher (실제 앱 동작 확인)
    ↓
결과 조합 → Design Doc 초안

구조가 단순하고 역할이 명확해 보였다.
code-researcher가 Opus 모델로 실행되면서 전체가 지연됐다. 다른 Agent들은 이미 끝났는데 하나를 기다리고 있었다.
입력에 포함되지 않은 소스도 조사하려 했다. 필요 없는 일을 하고 있었다.
external-researcher 하나가 디자인 도구, 문서 도구, 웹을 전부 처리해야 했다. 각 플랫폼의 특성이 다른데, 하나의 프롬프트에 다 담으려니 비대해졌다.
Agent 단위가 아니라 Task 단위로 생각을 바꿨다.
입력: "A 기능 개선. 디자인: ..., 기획서: ..."
    ↓
Main Agent가 입력 분석 → 필요한 Task …
articles.title: Claude Code Custom Agent 설계 여정: Agent 중심에서 Task 중심으로

articles.author: Arun Shinde
articles.description:
This is a submission for the New Year, New You Portfolio Challenge Presented by Google AI
I am a Principal Product Architect and Google Developer Expert (Cloud) with over 12 years of experience in designing scalable, security-first cloud ecosystems. My goal with this portfolio was to move beyond a static résumé and create a "System Architect’s Console"—a live, gamified environment that reflects my expertise in migrating complex monoliths to containerized, AI-driven architectures. I wanted to show how a senior-level perspective can leverage Google AI to solve enterprise-scale problems like compliance and developer productivity.
My tech stack is intentionally lean to maximize performance and maintainability:
Backend: Python 3.12 (Standard Library only) hosted on Google Cloud Run. 
Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript (ES6 Modules) and pure CSS with a "Midnight Architecture" theme. 
AI Integration: I used Google Antigravity as my primary development tool. 
Gemini AI: I integrated the Gemini 3 Flash Preview model via raw HTTP calls (no SDKs) to power a "Technical Consultant" persona that answers recruitment queries using my specific project data.
Gamification: Built a custom "System Audit" engine using the IntersectionObserver API to track user engagement and unlock technical "milestone logs" as visitors explore my career path.
I am most proud of achieving a 95+ PageSpeed score while maintaining a fully interactive, AI-powered experience.  Specifically, the License Compliance Agent feature demonstrates how I've bridged the gap between BigQuery and Generative AI to reduce manual audit effort by 70%. Successfully implementing this entire project with zero third-party libraries and zero critical vulnerabilities (following the security-first principles I’ve applied to ISO 27001 and SOC2 audits) is a testament to the power of the Google Cloud ecosystem.
articles.title: New Year, New You: Architecting a High-Performance AI Portfolio using Python and Gemini
